root_cause.text: The imx8m block controller remove path used a malformed for-loop condition in `imx8m_blk_ctrl_remove()` that tested `bc->onecell_data.num_domains` as a constant truthy value instead of bounding `i`, causing unbounded indexing into the `bc->domains` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `for (i = 0; bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)` to `for (i = 0; i < bc->onecell_data.num_domains; i++)`, and both the CVE description and commit message explicitly state this fixes an out-of-range access of `bc->domains`.

intent_record.how: This fixes the loop so it stops after processing all valid power domains instead of using a constant nonzero condition that could cause an unbounded iteration and out-of-bounds access during device removal.
